why: A = proposition_5_1_3_compare (universes 0) is literally B: for auxiliary norms N₀, N₁ of any strong bundle (no tameness) there is a continuous f : X → ℝ, f > 0, with f(P w)·N₀(w) ≤ N₁(w) ≤ f(P w)⁻¹·N₀(w) for all w ∈ Y_{0,1}.
